schema.target_translation: Laravel 12 Schema Builder plus driver-specific append-only triggers
schema.canonical_timestamp_storage: UTC ISO-8601 text in proof; UTC DATETIME(6) in Laravel translation
schema.raw_body_contract: Private immutable filesystem/object storage bytes are authoritative; database rows store path, length, media metadata, source reference, and verified SHA-256
schema.provider_versioning: Provider changes append a new provider_version row; existing evidence never changes provider metadata
schema.source_run_lifecycle: Insert one terminal immutable attempt row after each completed, failed, or partial attempt; a resume is a new row linked by parent_resume_run_id
schema.observation_versioning: Every revision appends a row with revision_number+1 and a same-identity supersedes_observation_id
schema.derived_versioning: Every score, bundle, category, snapshot, link, and backtest row is keyed by its calculation/scoring/config lineage and never updated

transaction_protocol: Write response bytes to a private same-filesystem temporary path while hashing; fsync and atomically rename before opening the database transaction.
Within one transaction insert the terminal source-run row, raw-artifact metadata, immutable observations, and the collection checkpoint declaration.
Use deterministic idempotency keys and unique constraints. A duplicate with identical hashes is a no-op; a duplicate identity with different bytes creates a new run/artifact version or fails closed.
Use a per-route advisory lock or distributed mutex and SELECT FOR UPDATE on the latest observation revision before assigning revision_number.
On deadlock or transient connection failure retry the whole transaction with bounded exponential backoff and jitter. Never retry parser/semantic/hash failures as transient.
If the database transaction fails after raw rename, quarantine the orphan by hash; the next run may attach it only after byte revalidation.
A crash or partial traversal appends a PARTIAL run. Resume creates a new run linked to parent_resume_run_id and starts from the last independently verified checkpoint.

access_control.collection_surface: CLI/worker only; no caller-supplied URL and no public ingestion route
prohibited_for_runtime_roles: write raw artifacts beneath a web-accessible directory
access_control.read_api: Future authenticated read-only endpoint with explicit policy and negative IDOR tests; no endpoint is added in Role 4

retention_and_export.evidence_retention: Indefinite for source runs, raw artifacts, observations, derived states, snapshots, event ledger, links, and backtest lineage unless a prospective governance policy authorizes archival.
retention_and_export.archive_move: Allowed only as copy-verify-manifest-switch; the content hash and old path remain in an append-only relocation ledger before old storage is removed.
retention_and_export.export_manifest: Canonical UTF-8/ASCII-safe CSV or JSONL files, row counts, ordered SHA-256 per file, schema/config/code/registry hashes, and raw-artifact existence/hash reconciliation

rollback.role_4: Delete only the new version-controlled architecture artifacts; no Laravel or user database state was changed.
rollback.future_migration_before_collection: Driver-specific down migration may drop all 11 empty tables in reverse foreign-key order after schema hash verification.
rollback.future_migration_after_any_evidence: Destructive down migration is prohibited. Quiesce writers, export and independently verify every table and raw body, create a replacement schema version, migrate by append/copy, switch readers, and retain the old schema read-only.
rollback.production_database: Not touched or inspected by Role 4

assumptions: Laravel source files and migration history are the authorized inventory boundary; no production database contents were inspected.
The sibling Laravel directory has no Git metadata, so Role 4 does not place unreviewed executable files there.
SQLite is used only for deterministic schema behavior proof. MySQL/MariaDB append-only trigger syntax must be separately generated and tested before integration.
Role 5 will collect only routes whose frozen source_decision is APPROVED_FOR_BOUNDED_COLLECTION and will treat current/revised endpoints as reconciliation-only.
unresolved_questions: Which MySQL or MariaDB engine/version is the eventual deployment target?
Which private raw-storage backend and retention authority will be approved before Role 5 collection?
Will the Laravel sibling be placed under version control before executable migration integration?
next_permitted_action: Role 5 may implement a bounded collector against the frozen contract, beginning with H.6 M2 and then H.4.1 liquidity routes, only after translating and independently testing the schema in an isolated Laravel database.
